top_choice_rationale: P001 is a discrete, mature and well-defined achievement: incretin physiology and the active form of GLP-1, with mechanism and clinical effect on glycaemia, weight and cardiorenal outcomes confirmed by independent trials. The three-person allocation (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) is defensible, with Holst and Drucker secure and Mojsov's priority for GLP-1(7-36) the one residual uncertainty. That does not justify withholding the prize, so no award ranks last.
